body.acceptance_criteria: SPEC_V2 §12 T16: a real SOP, an OWL file and a BPMN diagram are each ingested end to end; the draft is published behind a human gate; a re-ingest creates the next draft version while the published row keeps its source and pack; a job bound to the procedure runs the PDDL steps; an unreviewed source never binds. Proven by 25/25 tests at lane head 46fc49e2 with the acceptance transcript.
body.assignment: The T16 slice (SPEC_V2 §12; issues #85, #448) under the programme's architecture governance: ingest the organisation's procedure sources as governed, human-reviewed procedures and let a bound job execute them.
body.responsibilities: The author job requests and drafts; the approver job decides every gate and is never its requester; the programme architect owns the contract and the Phase-G review; the BCM owns the benefit.
body.scope: procedures.ingest_sop, procedures.ingest_rdf, procedures.ingest_process, procedures.review_source, procedures.publish, re-ingest versioning and a bound job's PDDL steps. Not in scope: the procedure catalogue UI (T18) and the process engine (S13).
